releaseNotes:
- Version 2.0.1
- Five fixes from the field list
- The gallery shows what the image shows
- An annotation follows the image, not the screen
- Stop lets go of the screen at once
- The ruler reads in the chosen unit
- The buttons wear their own colour
- A long name stays in its tile
- The checkbox says it plainly
- The list opens while you type
- A new name arrives already typed
- The repair is kept honest
- An update repairs what it finds
- The calibration window wears the app
- A calibration can outlive the image
- Vivix: the ruler takes the panel's real pixel pitch, not a hardcoded one
